# Rescue Legs

> > Medical-grade compression stockings and socks designed to support circulation and provide relief for various conditions including varicose veins, swelling, lipedema, and arthritis.

Rescue Legs offers a comprehensive collection of compression hosiery across multiple compression levels (8-15 mmHg through 30-40 mmHg), styles (knee-high, thigh-high, pantyhose), and specialized designs (dress socks, cushioned socks, maternity). The site features premium brands like Essence, Couture Silver, and The Natural.
